title: Grok Bot goes model-agnostic
subtitle: Musk: SpaceX bots will use the best backend — Claude, MidJourney, Suno — plus a lightning-fast Grok 4.8 path.
as_of: Grounded in Jim's Interest Journal research and content notes for Wed Oct 7, 2026. Routing rules, pricing and data handling were not disclosed.
